summary: COMMAND_SPECS is now the single command catalog: parse() resolves the command through the spec table (exact name/alias) before dispatch, so no name parses without a spec. Added specs for /reasoning, /tree, /output, /input, /scheduled, /reload, /skills, /templates and the `resource` alias of /resources; removed the /review Diff alias (keep /diff). New SlashCommand::Reasoning{level} is handled by the shared headless dispatcher (so {"type":"command","text":"/reasoning high"} sets the effort used by the next provider request) and by the TUI dispatcher; the TUI /help hand patch is gone. /approval with no argument only displays the current mode (Approval{mode:Option}); /yolo with no argument toggles (Yolo{enabled:Option}). Host-routed controls (tree/output/input/scheduled/reload/skills/templates) return SlashError::HostControl from parse; hosts still route them first via their dedicated grammars, and headless now gates /reload|/skills|/templates on resource_control() since they are no longer resource-template candidates.
commands_run: cargo test --locked --test tui_busy_diff --test tui_command_palette --test slash --test approval_owner --test stage1_extension_hooks --test dag

validation_result.headless_reasoning_command_changes_the_n: pass (tests/slash.rs; run_headless + OpenAI Responses recording server: request 1 has no reasoning.effort, request after /reasoning high has reasoning.effort=high)
validation_result.cargo_test_full: all pass except environment-sensitive tests: tests/dag.rs dag_spawn_keeps_a_live_worker_stdin fails consistently (spawns a /bin/sh stub worker; unrelated to slash); stage1_extension_hooks and core extension_resume_commit_tests timed out under full-suite load and pass on rerun; one PTY tui preview test flaked once and passed on rerun

notes: Tests changed because they asserted old behavior: tests/slash.rs (Yolo/Approval now Option, /review now unknown), tests/approval_owner.rs (Yolo{enabled:Some(..)}), tests/tui_busy_diff.rs (dropped /review alias cases), tests/tui_command_palette.rs (template fixture renamed review.md->diff.md since /review is no longer a reserved built-in). Behavior notes: a template named review is now invocable; templates named tree/output/input/scheduled/reload/skills/templates/reasoning/resource are now reserved; /approval no-arg in headless returns {mode, policy_mode, changed:false}; added pub headless::approval_mode_label. No new non-test unwrap/expect/panic, no unsafe, no new Arc<Mutex>.
